This is a real AI built for Southeast Asia. It sounds sure even when it is wrong. That makes it great practice! Ask it anything, then decide: would you trust it?
Chat with a real AI built for Southeast Asia. Nothing to download: just ask. It writes a new answer every time, and it can be wrong. Your job: catch it.
AI learns mostly from English text, so answers in Cebuano, Ilokano and Hiligaynon can be weaker or mixed with other languages. That is a real limit of AI, worth noticing!
Is the answer as good? AI is often weaker in Filipino and regional languages.
Good catch! AI can make things up and still sound sure. That is why we check.
